title: Phase 12 Launch Execution — LCH-02 deployment/rollback/first-session contract schema
description: Repository-only LCH-02 launch execution contract (PLAN.md section 8 LCH-02: deploy to production, monitor dashboards, on-call engineer active; success is production live and a first real session completing). This contract is a fillable foundation only: nothing is deployed, no launch session exists, no on-call is active, no dashboard is monitored, and rollback authority is PENDING. All status values use the vocabulary NOT_DEPLOYED | PENDING | NOT_ACTIVE. DEPLOYED, ACTIVE, LIVE, GO, GREEN, APPROVED, AUTHORIZED, EXECUTED, COMPLETED, and any non-null launchSessionId/endpoint/sessionId are forbidden positive claims and are never valid values here. The release state machine is NOT forked: this contract references the Phase 11 DEP-06 machine (infra/deployment-contracts/release-record.example.json, validated by scripts/validate-deployment-release) whose legal chain is prepared → staging_verified → canary_observing → promote_pending → promoted, with rollback_required → rolled_back | aborted escapes. Rollback compatibility refers only to existing repository migration markers in infra/deployment-contracts/manifest.json; no live rollback target is invented. It does not duplicate or override config/current-state.json, which remains the authoritative source of truth (0/17 gates complete, 0/14 phases accepted, production pre-production).

deployed.description: Nothing is deployed. true is a forbidden positive claim: repository-only work never deploys, provisions, or starts anything.

stage.description: Deployment stage. NOT_DEPLOYED is the only truthful value; DEPLOYED/STAGING_LIVE/PROD_LIVE are forbidden positive claims.

releaseState.description: Phase 12 does not instantiate or advance a release record. The Phase 11 DEP-06 record (infra/deployment-contracts/release-record.example.json) is the machine instance and remains prepared; this field only records that the referenced machine's outcome is PENDING.

launchSessionId.description: No launch session exists. Any non-null launch session identifier is a forbidden positive claim and is rejected.

launchWindow.description: Launch window is PENDING owner/SRE; OPEN/ACTIVE/COMPLETE are forbidden positive claims.

allowedTransitions.const: prepared → staging_verified → canary_observing → promote_pending → promoted | rollback_required → rolled_back | aborted
allowedTransitions.description: The exact Phase 11 DEP-06 legal transition chain. Phase 12 references this machine and defines no alternative transitions.

forked.description: Declares that Phase 12 does not fork or redefine the Phase 11 release state machine. true is rejected.

firstSessionCompleted.description: No first session has completed. true is a forbidden positive claim.

firstRealSessionCompleted.description: No first REAL session has completed. Synthetic local fixtures never satisfy LCH-02; a real production session is owner-operated and outside this repository.

firstSessionEvidence.description: First-session evidence is template-only and PENDING; no transcript, recording, or session evidence is claimed.

sessionId.description: No session identifier exists. Any non-null value is a forbidden positive claim.

recordedAt.description: No session timestamp is recorded. Any non-null value is a forbidden positive claim.

onCallActive.description: No on-call engineer is active. true is a forbidden positive claim.

onCallRoster.description: On-call roster is PENDING; no engineer is named.

escalationPath.description: Escalation path is PENDING; no contact channel is defined or claimed.

rollbackAuthority.description: Rollback authority state. Only PENDING is truthful in repository-only work; AUTHORIZED, APPROVED, GRANTED, and ACTIVE are forbidden positive claims and are rejected.

authorizedBy.description: No rollback authority is named. Any non-null name is a forbidden sign-off claim.

decisionDate.description: No rollback decision date exists. Any non-null value is a forbidden claim.

plan.description: Rollback plan state. A template procedure is documented in docs/runbooks/production-rollback.md; the plan itself stays PENDING and is never EXECUTED or COMPLETE here.

dashboardMonitored.description: No dashboard is monitored. true is a forbidden positive claim; Mission Control dashboards are a separate future artifact and not part of this foundation.

endpoint.description: No monitoring endpoint exists. Any URL or host value is a forbidden positive claim and is rejected.

observabilityConnected.description: No observability platform connection is established.

alertsActive.description: No alert is active. true is a forbidden positive claim.

status.description: Monitoring status is declared NOT_ACTIVE; ACTIVE/MONITORING/LIVE are forbidden positive claims.

paths.description: No evidence paths exist. The array is structurally forced empty so no executed evidence can be claimed.
